parsed_hypotheses.title: Query timeout due to increased cache TTL
parsed_hypotheses.description: The increase in the report cache TTL from 300s to 600s (record_ids: deploys#1) at 11:30 UTC may have led to stale data being served, causing query timeouts as seen by the new error signature x900 (evidence_ids: app-logs#2952, app-logs#2949, app-logs#2948).

parsed_hypotheses.title: Migration dropping index idx_orders_created_at
parsed_hypotheses.description: The migration 0042 that dropped the index idx_orders_created_at on orders (record_ids: deploys#0) at 12:02 UTC may have caused performance degradation, leading to query timeouts and gateway timeouts as seen by the new error signatures x900 and x550 (evidence_ids: app-logs#2952, app-logs#2754).
